contract.definition: u : User = User.allInstances()->any(x : User | x.UserID = uid), c : BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(y : BookCopy | y.Barcode = barcode)
contract.precondition: User.allInstances()->one(x : User | x.UserID = uid) and BookCopy.allInstances()->one(y : BookCopy | y.Barcode = barcode and y.Status = "LOANED" and y.IsReserved = false) and Reserve.allInstances()->forAll(r : Reserve | r.BookCopy <> c or r.Status <> "OPEN")
contract.postcondition: c.Status = "LOANED" and c.IsReserved = true and Reserve.allInstances()->exists(r : Reserve | r.oclIsNew() and r.ReserveDate = Today and r.Status = "OPEN" and r.User = u and r.BookCopy = c and Reserve.allInstances()->includes(r)) and result = true

evaluation.contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::makeReservation(uid:String,barcode:String): Boolean {
          definition:
          u : User = User.allInstances()->any(x : User | x.UserID = uid), c : BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(y : BookCopy | y.Barcode = barcode)
            
            precondition:
          User.allInstances()->one(x : User | x.UserID = uid) and BookCopy.allInstances()->one(y : BookCopy | y.Barcode = barcode and y.Status = "LOANED" and y.IsReserved = false) and Reserve.allInstances()->forAll(r : Reserve | r.BookCopy <> c or r.Status <> "OPEN")
            
            postcondition:
          c.Status = "LOANED" and c.IsReserved = true and Reserve.allInstances()->exists(r : Reserve | r.oclIsNew() and r.ReserveDate = Today and r.Status = "OPEN" and r.User = u and r.BookCopy = c and Reserve.allInstances()->includes(r)) and result = true
            
        }
